gloss: scratch paper; blank side of used paper

definitions.gloss: scratch paper; the unused back side of printed paper
definitions.explanation: paper that has been used on one side and is reused for notes or drafts on the blank side

examples.japanese: {裏紙|うらがみ}をメモ{用紙|ようし}に{使|つか}う。
examples.english: To use scratch paper as memo paper.

examples.japanese: {印刷|いんさつ}ミスの{紙|かみ}は{裏紙|うらがみ}として{再利用|さいりよう}する。
examples.english: Papers with printing mistakes are reused as scratch paper.

examples.japanese: うちの{会社|かいしゃ}では{裏紙|うらがみ}の{使用|しよう}を{推奨|すいしょう}している。
examples.english: Our company encourages the use of scratch paper.

notes:
{裏紙|うらがみ} refers to paper that has been used on one side and is reused on the blank back side.

KANJI MEANING:
{裏|うら} (back side) + {紙|かみ} (paper)

COMMON USES:
- メモ{用紙|ようし}として{使|つか}う: use as memo paper
- {印刷|いんさつ}ミスを{再利用|さいりよう}する: reuse misprinted paper
- {計算|けいさん}{用紙|ようし}: scratch paper for calculations

WORKPLACE CULTURE:
Using {裏紙|うらがみ} is encouraged in many Japanese offices and schools as an eco-friendly practice to reduce paper waste.

CAUTION:
Be careful not to use paper containing confidential ({機密|きみつ}) information as scratch paper.

RELATED:
- {再利用|さいりよう}: reuse, recycling
- {表|おもて}: front side (of paper)
